module.app_service_environments:data.external.ase_ilb_ip declares depends_on = [azurerm_template_deployment.ase], but its `program` argument already interpolates `lookup(azurerm_template_deployment.ase.outputs, \"id\")`, so Terraform already infers this ordering. module.recovery_vaults:resource.azurerm_site_recovery_replication_policy.policy declares depends_on = [azurerm_recovery_services_vault.asr_rg_vault] while also setting `recovery_vault_name = azurerm_recovery_services_vault.asr_rg_vault.name`; the ordering is already implicit, so the explicit depends_on is redundant.

module.virtual_wans.module.hubs:resource.azurerm_point_to_site_vpn_gateway.p2s_gateway also declares depends_on = [azurerm_vpn_server_configuration.p2s_configuration], but `vpn_server_configuration_id = azurerm_vpn_server_configuration.p2s_configuration[0].id` already orders it after the server configuration.

module.virtual_wans.module.hubs:resource.azurerm_vpn_gateway.s2s_gateway declares depends_on = [azurerm_virtual_hub.vwan_hub], but `virtual_hub_id = azurerm_virtual_hub.vwan_hub.id` already implies that ordering. The depends_on is redundant.

module.aks_clusters:resource.azurerm_kubernetes_cluster.aks enables Azure AD-managed RBAC (`role_based_access_control.azure_active_directory.managed = true`), which requires the "AAD-V2" preview feature of Microsoft.ContainerService to be registered first. That registration is performed by module.aks_clusters:resource.null_resource.register_aks_msi_preview_feature (a ~30 minute az CLI loop), but nothing orders the cluster after it: the null_resource has no dependents and the cluster has no reference to it. Both will run in parallel and cluster creation can fail with a feature-not-registered error. Add `depends_on = [null_resource.register_aks_msi_preview_feature]` to the AKS cluster.
